prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1280; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a collision at an intersection. Insured vehicle was turning left when it was struck by the claimant's vehicle traveling straight through. Initial call received from the claimant, who reports a shoulder injury and is seeking medical attention. Claimant has not indicated retention of legal counsel. Scene photos requested.

Entry 2: Recorded statement obtained from the insured. States the left turn was made on a green arrow and the oncoming vehicle appeared to be accelerating through the yellow. Insured reports no prior claims in the last several years. Police report requested from the responding agency.

Entry 3: Police report received. Responding officer documented both vehicles' positions and noted the claimant stated she had been traveling at the posted limit. Citation issued to neither driver at scene. Witness information listed, follow-up contact to be attempted.

Entry 4: Claimant contacted to discuss the shoulder injury. Claimant reports ongoing pain and limited range of motion and has provided initial medical records from the treating facility. Claimant was advised of the claims process and that the adjuster is available to answer questions. No attorney referenced in conversation. Medical records under review.

Entry 5: Independent witness reached by phone and confirmed the oncoming vehicle entered the intersection after the signal changed to yellow. Witness statement to be documented in writing. Liability assessment in progress, pending review of scene photos, the vehicle damage estimate, and the medical file for the shoulder injury.
